summary: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you build things that last and carry real weight; other days you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you build things that last and carry real weight; other days you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control. The work is holding both without picking a side. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you think for yourself and break the mold.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes — or you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control.
integration: Let discipline and limits and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you think for yourself work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
